originalTitle: An Amazon cargo plane crashed at Miami International Airport

content: A plane bearing an Amazon logo overran the runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday during landing, crashing into vehicles and resulting in multiple injuries. The extent of the damage or the seriousness of the injuries was not clear at the time of publication. In the aftermath of the incident, the FAA released a statement saying: > 21 Air Flight 7598 overran the runway after landing at Miami International Airport around 2 p.m. local time on Sunday, Sept. 6. The Boeing 767-300 cargo aircraft departed from Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport in San Juan, Puerto Rico. As a result, flights at the airport were grounded and over 60 Miami-Dade Fire Rescue units were deployed to the scene. When MDFR arrived, the plane was on fire and spewing heavy smoke, according to reports. Video from the scene posted by NBC 6 (below) clearly shows the Amazon logo on the plane’s tail and thick smoke rising from the scene where the plane came to a stop on the other side of the road from the airport. Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nantel told The Verge: > “We can confirm that an Amazon Air plane operated by 21 Air experienced an incident while attempting to land at Miami International Airport today. This is a fast-moving situation and we’re still gathering details. We’re working closely with local authorities and officials to understand exactly what happened. Right now, our absolute priority is the safety, well-being, and care of everyone involved. We’re doing everything we can to support those affected.” Update September 6th: Added comment from Amazon.
chineseTitle: 一架亚马逊货机在迈阿密国际机场坠毁
chineseSummary: 周日，一架带有亚马逊标志的飞机在迈阿密国际机场着陆时冲出跑道，撞上车辆，造成多人受伤。截至发稿时，尚不清楚损坏的程度或伤害的严重程度。事件发生后，美国联邦航空局发表声明 […]
chineseContent: 周日，一架带有亚马逊标志的飞机在迈阿密国际机场着陆时冲出跑道，撞上车辆，造成多人受伤。截至发稿时，尚不清楚损坏的程度或伤害的严重程度。事件发生后，美国联邦航空局发表声明称： > 21 号航空 7598 号航班于下午 2 点左右降落在迈阿密国际机场后冲出跑道。当地时间9月6日星期日，这架波音767-300货机从波多黎各圣胡安路易斯·穆尼奥斯·马林国际机场起飞。结果，机场航班停飞，超过 60 名迈阿密戴德消防救援队被部署到现场。据报道，MDFR 抵达时，飞机起火并喷出浓烟。 NBC 6 发布的现场视频（下图）清楚地显示了飞机尾部的亚马逊标志，以及飞机在机场马路另一边停下时的现场升起的浓烟。亚马逊发言人 Kelly Nantel 告诉 The Verge：“我们可以确认，21 Air 运营的一架亚马逊航空飞机今天在试图降落迈阿密国际机场时发生了事故。情况瞬息万变，我们仍在收集细节。我们正在与地方当局和官员密切合作，以了解到底发生了什么。目前，我们的绝对首要任务是确保所有相关人员的安全、福祉和照顾。我们正在尽一切努力为受影响的人提供支持。” 9 月 6 日更新：添加了来自亚马逊的评论。
